title: Sun-Ken Rock
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Former delinquent Ken Kitano follows the girl he loves, now a police officer, to Korea, where he ends up leading a street gang that grows into the country's most powerful criminal organization. He hides his role from her while fighting rival gangs, yakuza and corrupt officials.
life_message: A good life is loyalty to your crew and protecting the people you love by strength.
